claims: Federal income tax rates for the 2025 tax year range from 10% to 37%.
2025 tax year federal income tax returns are filed in 2026.
The IRS uses seven progressive tax brackets ranging from 10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, to 37%.
For Single filers, 10% tax rate applies to income up to $11,925.
For Single filers, 37% tax rate applies to income of $626,351 or more.
For Married Filing Jointly, 10% tax rate applies to income up to $23,850.
For Married Filing Jointly, 37% tax rate applies to income of $751,601 or more.
For Head of Household, 10% tax rate applies to income up to $17,000.
For Head of Household, 37% tax rate applies to income of $626,351 or more.
The deadline to file 2025 federal tax returns is April 15, 2026.
